summary: structural_objective_fix_voice_invariant_role: causal-objective-alone REFUTED by measurement (causal+revision-gate+clause-head encoder still 0.017/0.000, inverts identically to bidirectional MLM; raw geometry healthy so content-not-variance problem). Lit diagnosis (Papadimitriou 2022 word-order-except-when-it-matters; Petty/Wilson/Frank 2022 role-mappings break on novel verbs; Henderson 2016 prediction/structure dissociable in LIFG) shows a PREDICTIVE objective (causal or gated) applies no pressure on role-GEOMETRY; brain licenses role at a structural SITE (arc/gap/feature-checking, nominative=actor regardless of position) via an operation dissociable from prediction. TOP FIX = token-level role-DISCRIMINATIVE contrastive across active/passive paraphrase pairs (pull same-referent arg together across voice, push agent-vs-patient apart within sentence), self-supervisable parser-free from the SYNTHETIC corpus (sidesteps Sachan 2021 silver-parse transfer wall). Bundle dependency-head aux (LISA) as mechanism-faithful control. Mandatory anti-collapse gate (within-voice separation) against SimCSE bag-of-words erasure. HARD-PASS >=0.70 both directions on HELD-OUT novel verbs+fillers AND within-voice>=0.85; HARD-FAIL <=0.55 or trained-only (memorization) or within-voice collapse. P_deflated(HARD-PASS)=0.30, MIDDLE-band more likely ~0.40.
plain_language: Our last fix to make the encoder understand who-did-what-to-whom regardless of sentence order failed exactly like before (it still flips the answer on passive sentences). Digging into brain science and AI research, the reason is clear: teaching a model to PREDICT the next word never forces it to represent WHO the agent is in a way that survives rephrasing — the brain uses a separate, non-predictive operation for that. The recommended fix is to directly train the encoder so that the SAME character gets the SAME representation whether the sentence is active or passive, while keeping the agent and patient distinct. Crucially, because our training sentences are machine-generated, we can build these matched active/passive pairs for free with no external grammar tool. Designed a cheap pass/fail test on brand-new verbs to make sure it genuinely learns the rule rather than memorizing.

summary: dynamic reindexing vs static encoder for voice-invariant role: wrong-FORM diagnosis CONFIRMED empirically (COGS: flat static seq2seq ~0pct on voice/novel-verb generalization, transformer AND LSTM; fix = structured canonical-OUTPUT decoder, not recurrence per se). Invariant lives in a constructed EVENT tuple, not encoder geometry; amodal alignment-pivot (CL-SRL analog) can substitute for perceptual grounding. RECOMMEND: small glass-box LEARNED recurrent reindexing DECODER on encoder latents, CUE-triggered (not PE), Sentence-Gestalt query-readout supervised against gold canonical (agent,patient) tuple, feeding existing FHRR slot; probe read off DECODER OUTPUT not encoder. HARD-PASS >=0.70 both voices held-out novel verbs + cross-voice consistency >=0.70; P_deflated=0.30.
plain_language: We keep failing to make the substrate understand who-did-what across active vs passive sentences because we kept trying to store that knowledge in the wrong place (the encoder that reads words). Research across brain science and ML shows the answer lives in a separately-built canonical event picture (agent=X, patient=Y), and the fix is a small, inspectable learned module that watches for grammar cues (like the passive marker) and rewrites the roles into that event picture - not a bigger word-reader. It also found we probably do not need real-world sensory grounding: a shared canonical event target during training can act as the anchor. Next step is to build and test that little reindexing module.

summary: cross_frame_entity_stability_lever: synthesized why entity re-id + role-attribution are TWO mechanisms (Greff binding taxonomy: Segregation vs Composition), not one; entity half (dominant, entity_consistency=0.795) fix = learned cross-mention consistency objective + VICReg/Barlow anti-collapse floor feeding the existing VET-confirmed content-gated WM (pattern-completion analog), not encoder-geometry contrastive alone.
plain_language: Looked at why the substrate mixes up which entity is which across different sentence framings (statement vs question vs tag). Biology (hippocampus pattern-completion, concept cells) shows the brain does this by storing an entity once and retrieving it by a learned content-addressed key, not by making raw sentence representations match. Proposed a learned (not borrowed/bolted-on) objective to give the substrate the same kind of stable key, with an explicit test for whether entities stay distinct (no collapsing them together).

summary: construction_acquisition_order: developmental lit (Brown/Tomasello/Diessel/Chien-Wexler/MacWhinney) gives ordered sequence reference->roles->coreference->non-canonical-order(passive/obj-relative)->complement-clauses->conditionals->situation-model; recommends competency #3 = cross-sentence coreference consuming #2 role output; non-canonical role order needs a dedicated override mechanism (ties to certified below-chance cross-voice encoder wall = Broca-like position-default); McGuffey g1-g6 lexically graded but syntactic-construction density unverified, needs annotation pass.
plain_language: We researched how children actually learn to understand sentences step by step, to decide what reading-comprehension skill our substrate should learn next. Kids learn who-things-are, then who-did-what-to-whom, then track who a pronoun refers to across sentences, and only much later handle backwards sentences like passive voice. This matches a wall we already hit: our system defaults to guessing the first-mentioned thing is always the doer, exactly like young children and even brain-damaged patients do before they learn to override that guess. Recommendation: build cross-sentence pronoun-tracking next, and treat passive-voice understanding as a harder, later skill that needs its own dedicated fix rather than just more practice.

summary: Calibrated HARD_PASS bar for per-construction-competency comprehension lift
plain_language: Calibrated the HARD_PASS bar for per-construction-competency comprehension lift using instructional-psychology literature: real single-skill reading interventions produce d=0.16-0.58 (~0.02-0.09 proportion-correct), so the guessed 0.08 floor was near the CEILING of realistic single-skill effects, not a fair bar. Recalibrated to a tiered bar (0.02 floor / 0.03-0.06 strong / 0.08+ stretch-or-cumulative). Cumulative-competency literature (Simple View of Reading additive/multiplicative debate, multi-strategy>single-strategy findings, Cain/Oakhill multi-deficit profile) supports additive-with-mild-synergy accumulation, not a threshold. Coreference (competency #3) has no direct causal effect-size study in the literature (evidence gap) but is predicted to land at or above thematic-roles by analogy to its mechanism-centrality.

summary: additive_vs_compositional_comprehension_measurement: lit-scan (Gough-Tunmer Simple View of Reading RC=D*LC multiplicative, Kintsch C-I construction+integration into situation model, Tomasello construction-grammar parasitism, Perfetti lexical-quality bottleneck) converges on COMPOSITIONAL/multiplicative not additive value structure for the growing competency library. The +0.015 blended lift from adding roles competency (climb_role=0.045 in isolation, byte-identical entity metrics) is diagnosed as likely a DILUTION ARTIFACT of averaging over items that do not structurally require roles, not a true low-value finding. Pre-registered cheap decisive test: re-slice already-logged metrics into role-CRITICAL vs role-INDIFFERENT buckets; HARD-PASS = large lift on role-critical bucket (~0 on indifferent) confirming compositional/bottleneck structure; HARD-FAIL = small lift even on role-critical items (genuine capability gap). Recommends changing HARD_PASS metric definition from additive blended margin to ablation-verified lift on AND-gated bottleneck item subsets, and designs a bottleneck-tiered can-fail test for competency #3 (cross-sentence coreference, Tier0 entity-only / Tier1 role-competitive / Tier2 role-reversal-under-coref).
recommendation: Run the cheap decisive re-slice on already-logged #1+#2 metrics BEFORE building competency #3; if HARD-PASS, adopt ablation-verified bottleneck-subset metric as the standing HARD_PASS definition going forward.
plain_language: We asked the brain-science literature whether adding reading skills to our substrate should show up as a small bonus added to an overall score, or as an all-or-nothing unlock on the specific tasks that need that skill. Multiple independent literatures (how kids learn to read, how the brain integrates sentence meaning, how grammar constructions build on each other) all say the second: skills gate each other rather than adding up, like decoding times comprehension in classic reading-education theory. This means our small +0.015 overall bump from adding role-understanding was probably diluted by measuring it on an averaged blend of tasks, most of which do not actually need role-understanding to answer -- not proof the skill is weak. Recommends re-measuring on just the tasks that require it, and designing the next skill (tracking who a pronoun refers to across sentences) with a proper all-or-nothing test from the start.

summary: persistent_schema_consolidation_model_building_architecture: transient situation-model (WM) vs persistent schema (cortex, CLS-replay) is the same predictive-coding engine at two timescales; schema-revision (accommodation) plausibly shares gate-shape with the CRP/MDL discovery gate (P=0.30, structural analogy not identity); comprehension-as-model-building holds broadly but is NOT universal (strains at motor/procedural/rote learning); science/causal understanding = same engine + a causal relation-type + eventual intervention-loop, not a new engine. Glass-box design: Tier-2 schema store reusing certified cls_discrete_budget_consolidate verbatim (WIRE not build), with a NEW schema-revision/contradiction gate identified as unaddressed by prior drills. Deliverable notes/research_persistent_schema_consolidation_model_building_architecture_2026-08-01.md.
plain_language: Studied how the brain builds durable long-term knowledge (not just per-passage understanding) and whether learning science needs a different mechanism than reading comprehension. Answer: same engine (predictive-coding, error-driven model update) at two speeds -- a temporary per-passage model and a slow, replay-built permanent schema we do not yet have -- plus science mainly needs a new relation type (cause-and-effect) added to the same growing skill library, not a rebuild. This is forward-roadmap architecture, not an immediate build.

summary: earn-structure-extraction-vs-supply-parser fork: brain does mention+role extraction via the SAME staged predict-hold-revise mechanism (roles: TDH/eADM/P600, already banked; mentions: DRT novelty-condition + ACT-R chunk activation + ERP activation/integration dissociation, new this cycle). Self-supervised structure induction (Manning et al 2020 PNAS, StructFormer, ON-LSTM/PRPN) is a genuinely constraint-clean glass-box EARN option not previously scoped, and is a low-marginal-cost extension of the already-spec-ready causal-LPC encoder (07-30 note). Honest fork: supply-trained-parser (Option A, near-zero effort, likely IS the forbidden bolt-on since UD label categories are externally-authored not substrate-earned) vs earn-it (Option B StructFormer-class induction, HIGH effort/uncertain ceiling at our scale, vs Option C reuse the 07-30 PE-gate to also trigger on referent-introduction, LOWER marginal cost). Middle case analyzed: training OUR OWN parser on UD-EWT is argued to still sit on the SUPPLIED side (categories come from an external human labeling scheme regardless of who trains it) -- flagged as REASONED, not a USER ruling. Tractable first step: Step0 hand-annotate small gold mention+role eval set (no compute); Step1 (gated on 07-30 encoder training) cheap CPU probe testing whether the PE-gate already spikes at gold referent-introduction points, pre-registered HARD-PASS/HARD-FAIL bands, P_deflated=0.28.
plain_language: Researched how the brain figures out who-is-mentioned and who-did-what-to-whom from raw sentences without being handed a pre-made parse, and mapped out the concrete build options for our substrate to learn this itself instead of borrowing an existing parser. Found a promising existing AI technique (self-supervised structure induction) that never needs a human-labeled grammar at all, which fits our no-bolt-on-parser rule cleanly. Also found that training our OWN copy of a parser on human-labeled data may still count as the forbidden shortcut, since the categories still come from outside, not from the substrate discovering them itself -- laid out the tradeoffs so the user can decide which path to take with full information.

summary: collapse brain-fidelity audit: our predictive encoder collapsed (rep_std 0.0078) from TWO fidelity gaps -- (1) target NON-external (regress to a learned co-adapting ungrounded token EMBEDDING, not external token IDENTITY) and (2) soft Barlow-only anti-collapse with a known variance loophole vs hard k-WTA sparse coding. Minimal collapse-proof config = external token-identity sampled-softmax target + top-k latent + homeostatic revival term.
plain_language: The cortex learns predictively for a lifetime without its internal representations degenerating; ours did (a known failure mode called collapse). The audit found two reasons ours is not truly brain-like yet: it tries to predict a moving, self-referential target instead of the fixed real signal (the actual next word identity), and its safeguard against collapse is a weak, loophole-prone one instead of the brain hard-wired sparse-coding mechanism. The fix is a specific, testable, one-change-at-a-time recipe that structurally cannot collapse.

summary: Lit-scan ranked missing brain mechanisms for language comprehension
plain_language: Lit-scan ranked missing brain mechanisms for language comprehension: precision-weighting (Friston/Feldman) is top-ranked and cheapest to test (scalar gain on existing error-driven update), multi-level prediction (token+event+discourse, Kuperberg & Jaeger 2016) second, neuromodulation (Schultz/Yu-Dayan) third with recommendation to fold into precision mechanism rather than build separately. plain_language: Checked our coreference/situation-model/flag-layer design against real cognitive-neuroscience literature. Most pieces are brain-APPROXIMATING (right idea, some simplifications); one piece (Principle B disjoint-reference as a hard rule) is genuinely brain-faithful; two pieces use a similarity/count shortcut where the brain does real relational or population-level competition. Report gives a build-ordered list of concrete next fixes, the cheapest first, aimed at closing the remaining cross-clause discourse coreference gap.

summary: biology-led encoder target representation drill: cortex meaning=componential/experiential feature layer (Binder) acquired via error-driven learning, NOT pure distributional (Huth topography=similarity not inference); relation/goal inference operates over event/predicate-level bound structure (Trabasso causal-connectivity, Zacks EST prediction-error boundaries, Zwaan situation-model indices), NOT word-level. Ranked recommendation: hybrid encoder target (experiential-feature-shaped word/concept fillers + event-level next-event-state prediction-error objective via existing TPR binding), P_deflated=0.40 capped novel-synthesis. Lock-compatibility of raw Binder norms as training target argued both ways, lean AGAINST direct training-target use (structural feature-category prior + diagnostic-only middle path recommended), flagged as Director call.
plain_language: Went to the neuroscience literature to answer: what should our meaning-representation actually look like, biology-first, given two dead-end shortcuts. Finding: the brain does not just track which words appear near each other (that only supports similarity judgments); it uses a richer feature-based meaning code (sensory/motor/affective/spatial dimensions) learned by predicting and being wrong, AND it computes goal/cause relations over whole event-structures (who did what to whom, why), not over individual words, with event boundaries triggered by prediction failures. Recommendation: change the encoder target to match both, reusing binding machinery already built. Also flagged a values question for the Director: is a published table of human meaning-ratings allowable as a training target, or does it count as the forbidden meaning-shortcut like a borrowed embedding? Argued both sides, leaning against direct-target use.
headline: word-level distributional (SGNS) supports similarity not inference; relation/goal inference is event-level, prediction-error-driven; recommend hybrid encoder target (experiential-feature word-fillers + event-level next-event prediction) reusing existing TPR binding
next_drill_candidate: implement rank-1 hybrid target as exp_dev cheap decisive test against registered HARD-PASS/HARD-FAIL thresholds

summary: Cross-run synthesis: the primary load-bearing brain-fidelity gap across all 4 event-prediction relation-inference negatives (v1 MSE mean-collapse, v2 retrieval-loses-to-copy, Option B crippled organ-routing, SR/TD near-null margin) is grading a Kintsch construction-stage mechanism (predict next event) on prediction-accuracy instead of feeding it to the already-validated coherence-filter integration organs (CausalLinkRegister 0.9722, coherence-gated loop, ToM sally-anne inverse-planning extension). SR/TD near-null-margin-across-ALL-baselines-simultaneously is the decisive new evidence (not available when the 5 background docs were written) that promotes this from a secondary complement to the PRIMARY explanation, ranked above segmentation-prediction-unity (real, secondary) and above scale/curriculum (explicitly tested and REJECTED for these specific failure signatures). Recommends repurposing the already-built SR/TD predictor + inverse-planning goal-scorer as an overgenerate CONSTRUCTION stage feeding the already-validated INTEGRATION organs, with a unified pre-registered can-fail test.
plain_language: Looked across all 4 failed attempts to build an event-relation predictor and asked: what single brain-deviation explains all of them? Answer: we kept judging a rough draft-generating stage as if it needed to already be the correct answer, when the brain never asks that stage to be individually right -- it overgenerates loose guesses and lets a separate coherence-checking step (which we already built and validated) pick the good one. The clearest evidence is the most recent attempt, where literally every baseline (including guessing the average, guessing randomly, and just copying the input) landed in the same narrow band as the trained model -- meaning accurately guessing the next event is close to impossible for anyone at that grain, so scoring on prediction accuracy was the wrong test all along. Recommends wiring the predictor as a candidate-generator into the coherence-filter organs we already validated, with a clear pass/fail test that would sharpen (not erase) our next investment if it fails.
headline: Wrong success-criterion (predict-accuracy vs construction-integration) is the primary load-bearing gap across all 4 negatives; SR/TD near-null-margin-across-all-arms is the decisive evidence; recommend construction (overgenerate candidates) + integration (already-validated coherence-filter organs) architecture; scale/curriculum explicitly rejected for these signatures.

summary: causal-coherence credit assignment 2x drill: disk-verified the 3 claimed reuse organs from Part B; CausalLinkRegister 0.9722 is a GIVEN-link write-then-read capacity/fidelity test, NOT a selector (would decode a WRONG written link with identical fidelity) -- corrected to storage-tail-only reuse. train_sr_transport/reach_value is directional (no backward variant exists); predecessor re-point requires retraining a genuinely new M_backward via the same TD(0) code path on reversed transitions, not a free transpose (M not shown symmetric). self_improving_loop.route_passage/decide_keep_or_revert IS the right abstain-band coherence-gated-adoption architecture but its decode_coherence_margins is hard-wired to AccumulateRegister role-margin, not causal reach -- reusable as pattern only. Named Gap 1 (no training-data pipeline for M_backward; only 25 GIVEN-link pairs exist, sparse for TD bootstrap) as the real bottleneck. Designed a 4-item can-fail pilot cell against the real recency-trap gold items (grapp_mcca_001/003/004/005) with pre-registered HARD-PASS/MIDDLE-BAND/HARD-FAIL bands and a glass-box reach-margin witness.
plain_language: Checked whether our existing memory organs can actually pick WHICH earlier story event explains an outcome (not just the most recent one). Found that one organ we thought could do this selection (CausalLinkRegister, 0.97 accuracy) actually only remembers a fact once told it -- it cannot judge between two plausible explanations on its own. The real judge has to be a different, not-yet-trained learned map (a backward version of an existing forward-planning map). Designed a small 4-story-passage test to check this before building it.

summary: self_extending_grounded_knowledge_prior_art: NELL coupled-constraint anti-drift (CPL mutual-exclusion + argument type-check across independent extractor views) + Chambers-Jurafsky coreference-conditioned schema induction (captures co-occurrence/temporal, NOT causal -- field consensus causal typing needs an independent cue-phrase signal) + Piaget disequilibrium trigger fused with Oudeyer-Kaplan learning-progress ranking = cleanest gating/prioritization operator; Carey Quinian bootstrapping = cleanest induction operator. Mapped onto our organs: self_improving_loop.route_passage = the coupling-gate analog but checks against ONE signal not an independent second view (Gap 1, largest); situation_model_accumulate role_vocab is static, no mint_new_role operator exists (Gap 2); flag layer detects within-vocab uncertainty, not whole-library disequilibrium (Gap 3 test target). CLS (hippocampal fast-bind / cortical slow-consolidate) + prediction-error schema update (van Kesteren, Gilboa-Marlatte) = the brain-systems grounding. Recommended first step: cheap 1-hr decisive test on 18 labeled causal items to check if existing coherence-margin already separates new-schema-needed vs fits-existing (no new build to run); if pass, build mint_new_role with MANDATORY second-independent-view (discourse-cue lexical check) anti-drift guard before promotion -- skipping this guard reproduces NELL long-tail low-confidence drift inside our store.
plain_language: Researched how other systems have built AI that keeps learning new knowledge from reading forever without a human teaching every fact (NELL ran 9 years this way). Good news: there is a proven blueprint for HOW to safely let the system grow -- have multiple independent checks agree before trusting a new belief, which is exactly why NELL avoided going crazy (it once nearly decided cookies and computer files were the same thing, caught by this check). Bad news: none of the prior systems ever solved the hardest part of our specific goal -- inducing genuinely CAUSAL understanding (X happened BECAUSE of Y), only similarity/timing patterns; every source agrees that needs a different kind of evidence we still have to build ourselves. Gave a concrete, cheap first test (about 1 hour, using tools we already have) to check whether we can detect a gap in understanding for free before building the new machinery, plus the one safety guard (a second independent check before trusting a newly-invented category) that must not be skipped.
next_drill_candidate: discourse-cue lexical causal-typing signal as the independent second view for the anti-drift guard (Do/Chan/Roth 2011 style), OR run the cheap decisive test itself and drill into whichever HARD-PASS/HARD-FAIL branch it lands on

summary: autonomous_grounded_knowledge_induction_prior_art: follow-on to the 09:41 self-extension-architecture note (which solved schema-minting+anti-drift, now disk-confirmed validated via exp_self_extension_grounded_realprose_v1 REAL_PROSE_SELF_EXTENSION_WORKS). This note targets the remaining wall: the LEXICAL/FEATURE content those organs type against is hand-supplied. Harnad/Cangelosi symbolic-theft = our validated mint operator, correctly reframed, not a new build. Resnik selectional-association induction is a portable glass-box lexical-candidate proposer for View-1. Andrews/Vigliocco/Vinson 2009: distributional stats provably cap on affect/causal content specifically (not general abstractness) -- no purely-textual counterexample found in this scan, the single biggest risk. Blum-Mitchell co-training conditions (conditional independence or expansion) are never rigorously verified for two purely-text-derived views anywhere in the field; NELL and our own validated co-fire-rate=0 empirical measurement ARE the field-standard practice, not a shortfall. Concrete half-day first buildable step given: selectional-association scorer seeded from 2 known WITHHOLD_ACT verbs, recall@10 + FP-vs-noise-control HARD-PASS/HARD-FAIL bands, with the predicted HARD-FAIL fix (fold View-2 grounded outcome-appraisal into induction-time ranking, not just post-hoc verification) pre-specified.
plain_language: Asked: can the system teach itself the WORDS that mean withholding/spite from raw text, instead of us hand-listing them, using only tools that never borrow an outside AI model? Found a clean prior-art trick (compose new concepts from words already understood) that turns out to be exactly what our validated new-concept-minting already does. Found a cheap statistical method (count which sentence-roles a verb tends to fill) that can propose candidate withholding-type verbs from raw text. But also found the fields strongest warning: this kind of word-counting method is known to fail specifically on words about feelings and intentions, because that meaning lives in bodily/felt experience text only reflects indirectly -- and nobody has published a pure-text fix for that. Gave a half-day test that will tell us honestly which side of that wall we are on, plus the specific pre-planned fix (reuse our own already-working feelings-grounding organ as part of the scoring, not just to double-check afterward) if the cheap version fails.
headline: Prior art gives a portable symbolic-composition mint pattern (already built, now correctly named) + a portable selectional-preference lexical-candidate proposer, but the field-wide distributional-affect cap (Andrews/Vigliocco/Vinson 2009) is unresolved by any purely-textual method found; half-day can-fail test + pre-specified fallback (fold View-2 grounded appraisal into induction score) given.
next_drill_candidate: run the half-day selectional-association cheap decisive test itself, OR (if capacity allows a parallel angle) drill Steels naming-game population-competition as a text-only re-derivation for future lexical-item induction beyond the withhold-verb class

summary: discourse_scale_grounded_integration_brain_drill: FORMALIZE per-component SHAPE/POSITION/METRIC compare vs brain (DMN hierarchical TRW Hasson08/Lerner11, event-segmentation Zacks07/Baldassano17, situation-model Kintsch/Zwaan event-indexing 5-dim, hippocampal relational binding Ranganath-Ritchey12/Chen17). Disk-verified live register role_vocab=[agent,mentioned] (read_anne_glassbox_v2_honest_ledger.py:428) -- NO goal/causation/outcome slot exists at all, exactly the Zwaan dimensions our reader omits. Adjudicated CRUX = representation gap (c) PRIMARY, not wiring (a) alone or missing hierarchical-window mechanism (b) alone -- appraisal fn is islanded reading a LOCAL 2-event bundle, and even if wired to the accumulated register today would decode noise because no goal/outcome content is ever written. predictive_coding.py (event-boundary analog, HARD_PASS) and coreference_resolver.py (relational-binding analog, FALSIFIED as recency-shaped not genuinely relational) both independently confirm the per-component picture. First step: extend role_vocab with GOAL/OUTCOME_VALENCE roles mirroring how CausalLinkRegister added CAUSE/EFFECT on the SAME accumulate organ (no new mechanism), re-point appraisal read side to the register; pre-registered HARD-PASS/MIDDLE-BAND/HARD-FAIL bands vs the 1.4pct-flat naturalistic baseline.
plain_language: Traced why our grounded reading only works on tidy example sentences but goes nearly silent (1.4 percent) on real book prose where the goal, the action, and the result of a scene are spread across several sentences. Checked the brain literature on how people stitch together a story that unfolds over paragraphs (a specific brain network holds the long view; a boundary-detector decides when one scene ends and the next begins; the mental model people build explicitly tracks WHO wants WHAT and WHAT CAUSED WHAT as its own tracked ingredients, not just who is being talked about). Then checked our own code directly and found the real problem: our systems running memory of a story literally has no slot for a goal or an outcome -- it only remembers who is being talked about. Thats like trying to read someones motive off a note that only records names. Recommended the smallest fix: add a goal slot and an outcome slot to the existing memory organ (reusing a trick we already used successfully elsewhere) and point the meaning-detector at it, with a pre-agreed pass/fail bar to test honestly whether that alone fixes it or whether a second problem (which sentence goes with which) is still hiding underneath.

summary: coherence-based binding selector build spec: SELECT (abstain-gated argmax, self_improving_loop.decide_keep_or_revert) unifies coref+causal+goal-outcome; SCORE is instance-specific (accumulate-margin for coref/goal-outcome, SR-backward reach_value for causal, still needs M_backward training per open Gap 1). Corrected several loosely-cited v2/v3/v4 numbers on disk-verify (v3=MIDDLE_BAND not HARD_PASS, v4=HARD_FAIL not 3-way pass).
plain_language: Designed one shared decision-making mechanism to replace recency-based guessing in three places (who a pronoun refers to, what caused an event, whose goal an outcome belongs to). Found the pick-the-best-candidate logic can be fully shared, but the underlying plausibility score cannot -- causal reasoning needs a new piece of machinery (a backward-looking learned map) that has not been built yet.

summary: relational_backward_reach_coherence_selector: redirect-corrected drill finds the goal-outcome decodability=0.0 result was confounded (synthetic 4-role/8-slot vs real 9-role/16-slot coref arm, plus an explicit load-matching manipulation never applied to coref); designs a fair, load-controlled, downstream-embedded, same-register re-test as the PRIMARY next step, demoting the SR-backward/reach_value organ to a conditional fallback only if the fair test also fails.
plain_language: We found the earlier test claiming the system cannot pick a coherent goal-owner (vs causal binding) was not a fair comparison -- it used much thinner data than the test that worked for pronoun resolution. This drill designs the fair rematch, and flags a bigger possible finding: the pronoun-resolution win itself might be an artifact of memory load rather than real understanding, and that needs checking first.
